[by Codex]

## Motivation

The DeepSeek-V4-Pro B200 TP8 aggregate AgentX recipe points to a pruned nightly image, so it does not document the image measured by [InferenceX #4556](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4556). This is the remaining cookbook coverage gap identified by its [Check 3 verdict](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4556#issuecomment-6477569268).

## Modifications

- Update the existing aggregate c1/c4/c8 recipe to `lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.22-cu130@sha256:e3a4f06001a29542fc4a8638536d9ffc5eb9c9942b08603c09b19a56eae4a1ae`, verified available on Docker Hub. The image records SGLang build `baa9befa381511cd4d56f83980951e5a45fffc6d`.
- Record the authorized sweep, recipe selectors and measured job links for the three aggregate and eight existing disaggregated points. The configurations are mirrored from SemiAnalysis submissions; the disaggregated image remains v0.5.21.
- Preserve all serving commands, environment variables, router/KV choices and unrelated cookbook cells. Dynamo remains `1.5.0.dev20260914` for the aggregate recipe.

| InferenceX PR | Cookbook page | Lanes | Measured pin |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [#4556](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4556) | [DeepSeek-V4 — Agentic Long-Context Deployment](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V4#agentic-long-context-deployment) | `dsv4-fp4-b200-dynamo-sglang-agentic-agg`, `dsv4-fp4-b200-dynamo-sglang-agentic-disagg` | Authorized [`/use 40604858012`](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4556#issuecomment-6474564697), head `99b6f1bcb99134ace8f2a681025bfee46c9808a5`. The final [attempt-2 collection](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40604858012/attempts/2) retains ten attempt-1 performance points and replaces c256 with attempt 2; each point links its actual execution attempt and job. |

## Validation

- Native AgentX decoder: all 402 router/KV variants are byte-for-byte identical to the baseline commands.
- All eleven #4556 points cross-checked against collected sweep artifacts, image digests and recipe fingerprints.
- Docker Hub tag and digest availability verified; eight KV flags across 48 aggregate variant uses exist in the exact image build.
- `node docs/scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs`: passed.
- `node --test docs/scripts/tests/*.test.mjs`: 52 passed.
- CI-pinned Mintlify: `mint validate` and `mint broken-links --check-anchors --check-redirects` passed.
- Pre-commit checks for the changed JSX file: passed.
- Native browser click-through completed all 402 selector combinations without a reported command mismatch. The subsequent share-link round-trip phase did not complete: Puppeteer reported `Runtime.callFunctionOn timed out`; full browser validation is therefore incomplete.
- No new GPU run or in-container parser check was performed. Docker is unavailable locally; the unchanged submitted commands were executed by the linked successful sweep.

## Accuracy and performance

Documentation image/provenance update. The successful source sweep and evaluations are linked above; this change adds no new benchmark results or serving changes.

<!-- pr-states:start -->
---

Latest PR Test (Extra): <!-- slot:pr-test-extra:start -->:x: [Run #40773051632](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40773051632)<!-- slot:pr-test-extra:end -->
Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): <!-- slot:pr-test-amd:start -->:heavy_minus_sign: **No AMD PR run found for this commit**.<!-- slot:pr-test-amd:end -->
<!-- pr-states:end -->
